minutes.headline: Commission voted to continue most hearings; a mis-sited septic tank will need an amended filing, and a $1,000 fine motion failed.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission funded a pollinator habitat wish list from a gift account, discussed an incorrectly installed septic holding tank at 25 Pearl Street, and continued several notice-of-intent hearings. It recommended approval of a town-meeting article for the local match on an agricultural preservation restriction, then spent the late evening working through changes to its land use regulations, with hunting, alcohol, firearms and hours left unresolved until a fuller board is present.

what_happened.line: A motion to impose a penalty for the mislocated septic holding tank at 25 Pearl Street failed on a roll call with every member voting no.
The commission told the 25 Pearl Street applicant to file an amended notice of intent rather than treat the tank as a field change; the penalty question was deferred to that hearing.
The commission voted to recommend the draft town meeting article for the local match on the Pierce agricultural preservation restriction.
The commission approved spending up to a not-to-exceed amount from its gift fund on pollinator habitat plants and supplies, all members voting aye.
Hunting, alcohol and firearm items in the land use regulations were deferred until a full board is present, and several notice-of-intent hearings were continued to April.

why_it_matters: The Pierce article asks Town Meeting to put up the town's local match toward a state agricultural preservation restriction, so residents may be asked to vote on that spending.
Rules on hunting, alcohol and firearms on conservation land remain unsettled, so the current rules stay in place until a fuller commission acts and a revised draft is circulated.
Because the Pearl Street penalty was deferred rather than decided, whether any fine applies will turn on the amended filing hearing.
watch_next: April 7, 2021: continued hearings for Wu/Benjamin, Proctor Masonry, 238 Fire Road 16, 386 Sunset Lane and 757 Chase Road.
April 21, 2021: the continued land use regulations hearing and the 137 Flynn Road hearing, with a revised draft of the regulations to be circulated beforehand.
